_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Xitulu xa waplayeri eka {width}x{height} grid.
Ni waplayeri {player_id}. Swiviko swo fana: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' kumbe w/s/a/d.
Nchumu: U tshama u philile kambe hinkwenu. Swiviko swa trails swi dlaya; ku hlota ka wala swi dlaya; ku hlota ka vuhomboloki swi dlaya vambirhi.

board.after_moves: Xibya lexi nga ni swiphemu swo hambana-hambana: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Mutlangi {player_id} u file hikwalaho ka ku famba loku nga riki enawini.

outcome.survived_win: Mutlangi {player_id} u ponile; lavan'wana hinkwavo va wile.
outcome.all_crashed: Vatlangi hinkwavo va tlumbe xithuthuthu hi nkarhi wun'we.
outcome.turn_limit: Loko ku fikeleriwe mpimo wa ndzhendzheleko - loyi a poneke nkarhi wo leha u hlula.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Hilelo ya mahungu ya finali (raza ku ya maha): {groups}
